message.content: {"action":"change_rounding","reason":"Current best is symmetric_preadd at coef_frac=15 with rne, giving 85.14 dB SQNR and 8520 um^2. Increasing precision is unavailable, and decreasing precision would lose ~6.4 dB SQNR for only a modest area reduction. Switching architecture has already been explored and the symmetric_preadd variant is already the best area/quality point. Trying a different rounding mode may preserve the high SQNR while potentially reducing mapped area or improving numerical quality at the same precision."}
